Scope of Supply** The seller shall supply all gym equipment and accessories as specified in the GeM Bid/BOQ, including all listed strength-training machines, cardio equipment, benches, racks, weight plates, dumbbells, barbells, k ettlebells and other gym accessories. The seller shall submit the relevant technical literature, product cat alogue, make/model details and compliance statement along with the bid wherever applicable. **3. OEM/Manufacturer Details** The bidder shall clearly indicate the make, brand and model of the equipment offered. The equipment shal l be new, unused and of current manufacture. Used, refurbished, damaged or reconditioned equipment sh all not be accepted.

**4. Quality and Construction** All gym machines shall have a sturdy and stable frame, appropriate load-bearing capacity, durable upholst ery, safe moving parts and suitable protective covers wherever required. Weight stacks, cables, pulleys, b earings and adjustment mechanisms shall be suitable for regular institutional/commercial use. **5. Warranty** The supplied equipment shall carry a minimum warranty of **one year from the date of successful installa tion and acceptance**, covering manufacturing defects and defects in workmanship under normal use. Th e seller shall rectify defects or replace defective parts, as applicable, without additional cost to the buyer d uring the warranty period. **6. Delivery and Installation** The seller shall deliver all items at the consignee location specified in the GeM contract within the stipulat ed delivery period. The seller shall be responsible for unloading, placement, assembly, installation and co mmissioning of equipment wherever required, without additional cost beyond the quoted contract price. **7. Demonstration and User Familiarisation** The seller shall demonstrate the safe operation and adjustment of the supplied equipment to the nominate d representative of the consignee at the time of installation, wherever applicable. **8. Inspection and Acceptance** All equipment shall be inspected by the consignee/authorised inspection team on delivery. Acceptance sh all be subject to verification of quantity, make/model, technical compliance, physical condition and functio nal performance. Items found defective, damaged or not conforming to the bid specifications shall be repla ced or rectified by the seller at no additional cost. **9. After-Sales Service** The seller shall provide after-sales support during the warranty period. Complaints regarding defects or m alfunction shall be attended to within a reasonable period, and necessary repairs or replacement of defecti ve components shall be carried out in accordance with the warranty terms. **10. Packaging and Transportation** The seller shall ensure proper packaging and safe transportation of all equipment to prevent damage duri ng transit. All expenses relating to packaging, freight, insurance, unloading and delivery shall be deemed i ncluded in the quoted price unless specifically provided otherwise in the GeM contract. **11. Documents to be Submitted** The successful seller shall provide, as applicable: - Tax invoice and delivery challan. - Equipment-wise make/model details and user manuals. - Warranty certificates. - Installation and commissioning report, wherever applicable. - Relevant product literature and safety instructions. **12. Price** The quoted price shall be inclusive of all applicable taxes, duties, transportation, packaging, unloading, ins tallation and commissioning charges, wherever applicable, and all other costs necessary for satisfactory c ompletion of the supply, in accordance with the GeM bid and contract. **13. Compliance with GeM Terms** All terms and conditions of the GeM General Terms and Conditions (GTC), the bid document and the resulta nt contract shall apply. In case of any inconsistency, the applicable GeM provisions and the terms of the co ntract shall prevail.

**14. Right of Acceptance** The Buyer reserves the right to reject any item that does not conform to the specifications or contractual r equirements. Any action shall be taken in accordance with the applicable GeM terms and conditions and th e contract. ### 15.
